applicabilityBasis.summary: yvUSDC-1 is an ERC-4626 share in Yearn's multi-strategy USDC vault. The exact product page identifies contract 0xbe53a109b494e5c9f97b9cd39fe969be68bf6204, USDC as the underlying asset and a price per share of 1.122925 at the 2026-10-28 fetch. Yearn defines vault shares as proportional claims on underlying assets allocated to yield strategies. This is a variable-value investment position redeemable through asset/share accounting, not a fixed-monetary-value payment instrument or a documented issuer obligation to redeem for national currency or bank deposits under GENIUS sections 2(17) and 2(22).

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-28. Assessment covers the tracked Yearn vault share separately from Circle's underlying USDC. The product documentation establishes proportional strategy shares and variable assets per share. It does not identify a legal entity undertaking fixed-dollar redemption of yvUSDC-1, so issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted. No USDC authorization, reserve attestation or licensing status is attributed to the vault. This assessment does not determine securities-law status or assert a GENIUS enforcement finding.
